info.title: agentmarkup public tools API
info.summary: Read-only machine-readability and passive security checks for public websites.
info.description:
Two endpoints back the tools on agentmarkup.dev. Both are read-only: they fetch public URLs on the caller's behalf and return findings. Nothing is stored on the caller's behalf beyond a short cache and rate-limit bookkeeping, and neither endpoint mutates the target site.

There are no API keys and no accounts. Access is rate limited per client IP and, after repeated requests from the same IP, may require a Cloudflare Turnstile token. These endpoints exist to serve the tools on this site; they are documented here so agents can use them correctly rather than by guessing. Use them only against sites you own or are authorised to test, and see the Terms of Service for the full authorised-use limits.

get.summary: Check a public website for machine-readability
get.description: Fetches a site's homepage, llms.txt, robots.txt, sitemap, markdown mirrors and at most one same-origin linked page, then returns the raw resources for analysis. Input is normalised to the site root before fetching, so 'example.com', 'https://example.com/some/page' and 'https://example.com' all resolve to the same origin.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: Public http(s) URL or bare domain. Normalised to the site root before fetching.

200.description: Fetched resources for the target origin.

post.summary: Check a public website for machine-readability
post.description: Same behaviour as the GET form, with the target supplied in a JSON body. Use this form when a Turnstile token is required.

200.description: Fetched resources for the target origin.

post.summary: Run a passive security scan of a public website
post.description: Checks publicly observable signals only: HTTPS and HSTS, Content-Security-Policy, clickjacking and MIME-sniffing protections, cookie flags, mixed content, security.txt, and SPF, DMARC and DNSSEC records. Sends no attack traffic and never attempts authentication. POST only, and cross-site browser requests are rejected.

200.description: Observed security posture for the target origin.

InvalidRequest.description: The supplied target was missing, malformed, or not a public http(s) address.

example.error: Enter a public http:// or https:// website URL.

MethodNotAllowed.description: The HTTP method is not supported for this endpoint.

Forbidden.description: A cross-site browser request was rejected.

VerificationRequired.description: Repeated requests from this IP require a Cloudflare Turnstile token. Solve the challenge with the returned site key and retry the POST form with `turnstileToken`.

example.error: Additional verification is required before running more checks from this IP.

RateLimited.description: Too many checker or security scan requests from this IP. Wait for the period given by the `Retry-After` header.

example.error: Too many checker or security scan requests came from this IP recently.

url.description: Public http(s) URL or bare domain. Normalised to the site root before fetching.

turnstileToken.description: Cloudflare Turnstile token. Only required after repeated requests from the same IP, signalled by a 403 with code `verification_required`.

ErrorResponse.description: Every error response carries a human-readable `error` and a stable machine-readable `code`.

code.description: Stable identifier an agent can branch on.

retryAfterSeconds.description: Seconds to wait before retrying. Present on `rate_limited`.

turnstileSiteKey.description: Site key to render the Turnstile challenge with.

RemoteResource.description: One fetched URL and its outcome. `body` is null when the fetch failed or the response was not text.

status.description: HTTP status, or 0 if the fetch never completed.

SiteCheckResponse.description: Raw resources fetched for one origin. Findings are derived from these client-side, so the response carries evidence rather than a verdict. There is deliberately no score, grade, or percentage.

normalizedFrom.description: The caller's original input when it differed from the normalised target.

sitemapSource.description: How the sitemap URL was discovered.

samplePage.description: At most one same-origin linked page, sampled so checks stay cheap.

SecurityScanResponse.description: Observed security posture for one origin, from passive checks only.

httpProbe.description: Result of the first-hop plain-HTTP request, used to check redirect-to-HTTPS behaviour.

securityTxtFallback.description: Legacy /security.txt location, checked when the well-known path is absent.

crossOriginRedirect.description: True when the target redirected to a different origin.

dns.description: DNS-over-HTTPS lookups for email and zone-integrity records.

DnsResult.description: One DNS-over-HTTPS lookup. Null when the lookup was skipped or timed out.

CacheStatus.description: Short per-target cache used to avoid re-fetching the same origin repeatedly.

ProtectionStatus.description: Current rate-limit position for the calling IP.
